profile.headline: Software Engineer at Health Plans, Inc.
profile.summary:
Extensive technical and financial background.  Experience in (but not limited to) the following technologies: ASP.Net, SQL, XML, JSON, HTML5, CSS3, C#, and VB.Net.

Specialties:  C#, ASP.NET, VB.NET, & SQL. Proficient in HTML, XML, JSON, MS Visual Studio, MS SQL Server, Javascript, Factset Cornerstone / Factset API, MS Office.  Working knowledge of Oracle, PSSQL Developer, and Angular JS.
